items.source: Add the given HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers.
items.translation: 添加给定的HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers。

items.source: Resolves HttpEntity and RequestEntity method argument values, as well as return values of type HttpEntity, ResponseEntity, ErrorResponse and ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 解析 `HttpEntity` 和 `RequestEntity` 的方法参数值，以及类型为 `HttpEntity`、`ResponseEntity`、`ErrorResponse` 和 `ProblemDetail` 的返回值。

items.source: Resolves Map, MultiValueMap and HttpHeaders method arguments annotated with @RequestHeader.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestHeader` 注解的 `Map`、MultiValueMap 和 HttpHeaders 方法参数。

items.source: Resolves the following method arguments: Annotated with @RequestPart Of type MultipartFile in conjunction with Spring's MultipartResolver abstraction Of type jakarta.servlet.http.Part in conjunction with Servlet multipart requests
items.translation: 解决以下方法参数： 带有 `@RequestPart` 注解 类型为 `MultipartFile`，与 Spring 的 `MultipartResolver` 抽象配合使用 类型为 `jakarta.servlet.http.Part`，与 Servlet 多部分请求配合使用

items.source: A Servlet-specific AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter that creates a NativeWebRequest from ServletRequestAttributes.
items.translation: 一个特定的 Servlet `AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter`，它从 `ServletRequestAttributes` 创建 `NativeWebRequest`。

items.source: An abstract base class adapting a WebArgumentResolver to the HandlerMethodArgumentResolver contract.
items.translation: 一个抽象基类，将 WebArgumentResolver 适配到 HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 契约。

items.source: Resolves Model arguments and handles Model return values.
items.translation: 解析 `Model` 参数并处理 `Model` 返回值。

items.source: Resolves Map method arguments annotated with an @RequestParam where the annotation does not specify a request parameter name.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestParam` 注解的 `Map` 方法参数，其中该注解未指定请求参数名称。

items.source: Resolves a SessionStatus argument by obtaining it from the ModelAndViewContainer.
items.translation: 通过从ModelAndViewContainer获取它来解析一个SessionStatus参数。

items.source: Provide access to the shared custom argument resolvers used by the RequestMappingHandlerAdapter and the ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver.
items.translation: 提供对由RequestMappingHandlerAdapter和ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver使用的共享自定义参数解析器的访问权限。

items.source: Extends AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver with the ability to handle method return values by writing to the response with HttpMessageConverters.
items.translation: 继承AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver，并具备通过HttpMessageConverters将方法返回值写入响应的能力。

items.source: Resolves arguments of type Map annotated with @MatrixVariable where the annotation does not specify a name.
items.translation: 解析带有未指定名称的 `Map` 类型参数的 `@MatrixVariable` 注解。

items.source: Resolves Map method arguments annotated with @PathVariable where the annotation does not specify a path variable name.
items.translation: 解决带有未指定路径变量名称的 Map 方法参数的 @PathVariable 注解。

items.source: Resolves an argument of type Principal, similar to ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver but irrespective of whether the argument is annotated or not.
items.translation: 解析类型为 Principal 的参数，类似于 ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver，但无论参数是否带有注解均适用。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestBody and handles return values from methods annotated with @ResponseBody by reading and writing to the body of the request or response with an HttpMessageConverter.
items.translation: 解析带有@RequestBody注解的方法参数，并通过使用HttpMessageConverter读取和写入请求或响应的主体来处理带有@ResponseBody注解的方法的返回值。

items.source: A Servlet-specific ModelAttributeMethodProcessor that applies data binding through a WebDataBinder of type ServletRequestDataBinder.
items.translation: 一个特定于 Servlet 的ModelAttributeMethodProcessor，它通过类型为ServletRequestDataBinder 的 WebDataBinder 应用数据绑定。

items.source: Return the argument resolvers for @InitBinder methods, or possibly null if not initialized yet via RequestMappingHandlerAdapter.afterPropertiesSet().
items.translation: 返回 `@InitBinder` 方法的参数解析器，或者如果尚未通过RequestMappingHandlerAdapter.afterPropertiesSet()初始化，则可能返回`null`。

items.source: An AbstractCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver that resolves cookie values from an HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 一个从HttpServletRequest解析 Cookie 值的AbstractCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver。

items.source: Return the configured argument resolvers, or possibly null if not initialized yet via RequestMappingHandlerAdapter.afterPropertiesSet().
items.translation: 返回配置的参数解析器，或者如果尚未通过RequestMappingHandlerAdapter.afterPropertiesSet()初始化，则可能返回`null`。

items.source: Resolves Errors method arguments.
items.translation: 解析 `Errors` 方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method parameters by delegating to a list of registered HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers.
items.translation: 通过委托给已注册的`HandlerMethodArgumentResolver`列表来解析方法参数。

items.source: Find a registered HandlerMethodArgumentResolver that supports the given method parameter.
items.translation: 查找一个已注册的、支持给定方法参数的HandlerMethodArgumentResolver接口。

items.source: Add the given HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.
items.translation: 添加给定的HandlerMethodArgumentResolver。

items.source: Add custom HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers to use in addition to the ones registered by default.
items.translation: 添加自定义的HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers，以补充默认注册的解析器。

items.source: A base class for resolving method argument values by reading from the body of a request with HttpMessageConverters.
items.translation: 用于通过从请求主体中读取数据，借助HttpMessageConverters解析方法参数值的基类。

items.source: Resolves argument values of type SemanticApiVersionParser.Version.
items.translation: 解析类型为SemanticApiVersionParser.Version的参数值。

items.source: Resolves method arguments of type RedirectAttributes.
items.translation: 解析类型为RedirectAttributes的方法参数。

items.source: Resolvers argument values of type UriComponentsBuilder.
items.translation: 解析器参数类型为UriComponentsBuilder。

items.source: Return the list of argument resolvers to use including built-in resolvers and custom resolvers provided via ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver.setCustomArgumentResolvers(List).
items.translation: 返回要使用的参数解析器列表，包括内置解析器和通过 ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver.setCustomArgumentResolvers(List) 提供的自定义解析器。

items.source: Return the custom argument resolvers, or null.
items.translation: 返回自定义参数解析器，或返回null。

items.source:
Configure the complete list of supported argument types thus overriding
the resolvers that would otherwise be configured by default.
items.translation: 配置完整的支持的参数字符类型列表，从而覆盖默认配置的解析器。

items.source: Provide resolvers for custom argument types.
items.translation: 为自定义参数类型提供解析器。

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client
items.translation: `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 接口在 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup
items.translation: `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 接口在 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.web.method.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.method.annotation` 包中 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 的用法

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.web.method.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.method.support` 包中 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 的用法

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation` 包中 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 的用法

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation
items.translation: `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation` 包中的用法

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestParam, arguments of type MultipartFile in conjunction with Spring's MultipartResolver abstraction, and arguments of type jakarta.servlet.http.Part in conjunction with Servlet multipart requests.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestParam` 注解的方法参数，以及结合 Spring 的 `MultipartResolver` 抽象类型处理的 `MultipartFile` 参数，以及结合 Servlet 多部分请求的 `jakarta.servlet.http.Part` 类型参数。

items.source: Support for testing Spring MVC applications via RestTestClient with MockMvc for server request handling.
items.translation: 支持通过 `RestTestClient` 与用于服务器请求处理的 `MockMvc` 来测试 Spring MVC 应用程序。

items.source: Resolves Map method arguments and handles Map return values.
items.translation: 解析 `Map` 方法参数，并处理其返回的 `Map` 值。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestHeader except for Map arguments.
items.translation: 解析带有 @RequestHeader 注解的方法参数，但 Map 参数除外。

items.source: Resolve @ModelAttribute annotated method arguments and handle return values from @ModelAttribute annotated methods.
items.translation: 解析带有@ModelAttribute注解的方法参数，并处理带有@ModelAttribute注解的方法的返回值。

items.source: Resolves arguments annotated with @MatrixVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有@MatrixVariable注解的参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @PathVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@PathVariable` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @RequestAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @SessionAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@SessionAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Contains built-in MockMvcBuilder implementations.
items.translation: 包含内置的MockMvcBuilder实现。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。

items.source: A base abstract class to resolve method arguments annotated with @CookieValue.
items.translation: 用于解析带有 @CookieValue 注解的方法参数的基础抽象类。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @Value.
items.translation: 解析带有@Value注解的方法参数。

items.source: No-op resolver for method arguments of type Continuation.
items.translation: Continuation 类型方法参数的无操作解析器。

items.source: Configure the supported argument types in @InitBinder methods.
items.translation: 在@InitBinder方法中配置支持的参数类型。

items.source: Support classes for annotation-based handler method processing.
items.translation: 支持基于注解的处理方法处理的辅助类。

items.source: Generic support classes for handler method processing.
items.translation: 处理处理器方法的通用支持类。

items.source: Annotation-based setup for Spring MVC.
items.translation: 基于注解的 Spring MVC 配置。

items.source: Provide custom argument resolvers.
items.translation: 提供自定义参数解析器。

items.source: Provide custom resolvers for controller method arguments.
items.translation: 为控制器方法参数提供自定义解析器。

items.source: Abstract base class for resolving method arguments from a named value.
items.translation: 用于从命名值解析方法参数的抽象基类。

items.source: Return a read-only list with the contained resolvers, or an empty list.
items.translation: 返回包含解析器的只读列表，或返回空列表。

items.source: Add resolvers to support custom controller method argument types.
items.translation: 添加解析器以支持自定义控制器方法参数类型。

items.source: Resolves servlet backed request-related method arguments.
items.translation: 解析由 Servlet 支持的相关请求方法参数。

items.source: Resolves servlet backed response-related method arguments.
items.translation: 解决由 Servlet 支持的与响应相关的方法参数。
